requirement.goal: Build a terminal-native SLM learning lab that creates a small language model from scratch, uses it on the GAD project itself, and improves its souls/reasoning workflows.
Make the main menu shell behave like a chat/composer interface with slash-command lesson routes, stable VCS ids, succinct quick prompts, and honest live speech/input status.

Efficient training and tuning on low-end equipment: bfloat16 mixed precision, gradient checkpointing, gc.collect memory hygiene, gradient accumulation for larger effective batch sizes, and post-training pruning/quantization for deployment. No accuracy or reasoning loss from any optimization.
